units.source_text: 幸运的是，这里有开了封的，我送给诸位每人一袋，

en.t: Fortunately, I have some opened packages here, so I will give each of you one bag,

units.source_text: 事实比空谈更重要，请各位当场尝一尝。

en.t: Facts matter more than empty talk, so please try it right here on the spot.

units.source_text: 有头痛、眩晕的，吃了它不到一分钟，

en.t: If you have a headache or feel dizzy, in less than a minute after taking it,

units.source_text: 头脑就会变得清晰起来，简直就像脱下戴着的帽子一样，觉得很舒服。

en.t: your head will become clear, as comfortable as if you had taken off a hat you were wearing.
